title: 5 Stocks to Buy for the Next Leg of the Nasdaq Rally

5 Stocks to Buy for the Next Leg of the Nasdaq Rally By 0
Small-caps and technology have stolen the spotlight in the first half of 2018, but where should we turn our attention for the next leg of the tech rally?
While I'm sure FAANG names -- Facebook (FB) , Amazon (AMZN) , Apple (AAPL) , Netflix (NFLX) and Alphabet (GOOGL) -- will see their share of attention, the truly big upside is likely going to be found in the combination of what has worked lately: smaller cap tech.
